verdict.rationale: Grok Build is documented only as a terminal TUI, headless CLI and ACP agent. The evidence shows no first-party desktop app and no visual diff-review feature. The TUI session dashboard and parallel worktree sessions are adjacent terminal features, and the Tauri desktop GUI is a community fork, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review diffs visually and run multiple sessions side by side in a desktop app
